title: Hosted-bob ephemeral-runner authorization
description: The signed dispatch payload the bob-site run-dispatch endpoint hands to an EC2 ephemeral container's entrypoint (run.mjs). One payload authorizes exactly one engagement: provision -> bind egress identity -> run bob -> stream curated events into Convex -> POST the sealed report to /api/reports -> destroy. The payload is the ENTIRE grant. The container holds no standing credentials and reaches nothing this object does not name. Validated identically at the dispatch endpoint (before signing) and at the entrypoint (after verifying the signature) so a tampered payload fails closed at the boundary.

schemaVersion.description: Authorization payload schema version. The entrypoint refuses a version it does not recognize (fail-closed); the engine is shared, but the wire contract is pinned.

engagementId.description: Stable id for this one engagement. Used as the partition key for run_events + runs rows in Convex, and as the container's self-naming identity. One engagementId == one ephemeral container == one sealed report. Never reused; the container destroys itself, so a second run is a new id.

issuedAt.description: Epoch ms the dispatch endpoint signed this payload.

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms after which the entrypoint refuses to start (fail-closed). A grant is short-lived; a signature that outlives its window cannot launch a container. The dispatch endpoint sets a tight window (minutes), not a session.

target.description: What bob is authorized to engage, and NOTHING ELSE. Interpretation depends on targetKind: a registrable HTTP scope domain (web), a git/clone reference (repo), or a chain+address smart-contract reference (sc). This is the fail-closed scope seed: the entrypoint binds the engine's scope gate (mcp/lib/scope.js assertHttpScopeDomain / validateHttpScanScope) to exactly this value. Out-of-scope reach is refused by the SAME gate the local rail uses; the runner adds no new bypass.

targetKind.description: Which engine target family bob runs (repo = source review, web = live HTTP target, sc = smart contract). Selects which scope-gate path binds and which surface family findings carry (the F-1 surface family in the real engine). This is a SELECTOR for the existing mcp engine paths, NOT a new engine path.

runMode.description: The bob workflow intensity, mirroring the local CLI workflow vocabulary (wave/handoff/brutalist/balanced/final/grade). Governs depth and the brutalist scoring lens; does not change the lifecycle order. Shared with the run-dispatch endpoint payload shape.

autonomy.description: The autonomy gradient — the one rule of the gate. 'autonomous' is only valid for zero-blast-radius targets (an OSS/local-style repo run). 'operator-approved' is REQUIRED before a container touches any live target (web/sc, or a private/staging/prod repo): a named human accountability has approved this exact engagement. The entrypoint cross-checks autonomy against targetKind and the scope gate and fails closed on a mismatch (e.g. autonomous + web is refused). This is a binding rule carried on the grant, never an onboarding step.

callbackUrl.description: The Convex deployment URL the runner writes curated run_events + runs rows to. HTTPS only. The runner authenticates these writes with the runner write-secret (carried out-of-band in the container's transport-layer environment, NOT in this payload and NEVER in model context) — the same secret-gate discipline convex/reports.ts uses for REPORTS_SECRET. Convex live queries are the streaming layer; there is no WebSocket/SSE/Durable-Object channel.

ingestToken.description: Bearer token the runner presents to POST the sealed report to bob-site's /api/reports, exactly as the `bob-report publish` CLI does today (Authorization: Bearer <token>). The runner is a PUBLISHER on the existing ingest path; it adds no new report surface. Held only at the transport layer; never enters model context.

accessPassword.description: The access password for the sealed /r/<slug> report this engagement will produce. The runner forwards it to /api/reports as `password`; bob-site hashes it (PBKDF2, report-crypto.ts) and stores only the hash. The plaintext lives only in transit and is delivered to the operator out-of-band. Never logged, never streamed into an event, never in model context.

scope.description: Optional explicit scope refinement for the fail-closed gate. Absent means scope is exactly `target`. Present narrows or attests; it can never widen beyond what autonomy permits.

allowedHosts.description: Additional in-scope hosts for a web engagement (e.g. an API subdomain). Each is run through the same assertHttpScopeDomain gate; an entry that fails the gate fails the whole grant closed.

labAuthorization.description: Operator-attested lab/private-target escape for a loopback/RFC1918 web target, mapping to mcp/lib/scope.js opts.labAuthorization. OFF unless explicitly present and signed; cloud-metadata/link-local/IPv6/.internal/.local remain ineligible even with it. Requires autonomy 'operator-approved'.

egressProfile.description: Name of the egress profile the container binds before bob runs (mcp/lib/egress-profiles.js). Determines the adversary's identity on the wire. Defaults to the engagement's provisioned profile when absent. The RESOLVED identity is disclosed back as egress_profile_identity_hash in the run's opening event — who the container IS on the wire, stated plainly, never as a badge.
